note: Page food is 60.2 g water. Row 144 is Portugal, water-soaked and pressure-cooked at 56.5 g water, and is the only cooked chickpea row in either workbook carrying verbascose. Rows 126, 129 and 132 are three boiled Egyptian Kabuli cultivars at 63.9 to 64.7 g water, which carry raffinose only. Graded close because the page food is boiled and unspecified as to cultivar.

Row 60 is a white Phaseolus vulgaris, canned and cooked, drained, at 57.9 g water against the page food's 63.1. Same species and much the same preparation; the canning liquor carried salt and ascorbic acid, which is why this is close rather than exact. Carries no verbascose.
